notes: noble relates to Purity (elevated way of life) and General morality.
blessed/cursed relate to spiritual purity/impurity and general moral standing.
repressed relates to self-discipline (Purity) and restriction of self (Liberty).
natural relates to the Purity foundation's idea of living in a 'natural' way.
snoops relates to unfair intrusion and infringement on liberty/privacy.
prying relates to unfair intrusion and infringement on liberty/privacy.
Directly relates to the Authority foundation (leadership and followership).
plant-neglecter implies a lack of care for living things.
Activism can be motivated by any moral foundation and is generally about moral causes.
meaningful can relate to Purity (elevated life, self-improvement) and General morality (value, significance).
cassanova relates to promiscuity, a Purity vice.
disturbing can relate to causing psychological harm or distress.
maverick/conformist relate to Authority (deference/defiance) and Liberty (independence).
social climber/nonconformist relate to Authority (status/deference vs. defiance) and Liberty (nonconformity).
